description: CVE-2026-44875 affects HPE Cray Programming Environment (CPE) versions 25.03 and 25.09 prior to 26.03. The vulnerability involves the deployment method of CPE on HPCM, which may allow a local unprivileged user to gain elevated access. This could lead to full confidentiality, integrity, and availability compromise of the affected system.
